blocks.text: CEBU CITY — A 48-year-old fire volunteer died after his motorcycle collided head-on with a counterflowing motorcycle driven by an allegedly intoxicated rider along the Transcentral Highway (TCH) in Sitio Maling, Barangay Babag, a mountain barangay in Cebu City, at 5:57 p.m. on Thursday, November 19, 2026. Police identified the fatality as Floranti Cavan Delima, 48, an active fire volunteer assigned to the Maguikay Fire Sub-Station. He was a native of Galaxy Compound, Maguikay, Mandaue City, and was residing at Sitio Hamtik, Barangay Babag, Cebu City.
